senses.sense_definition: A collapsible tube fitted with a hypodermic needle containing a single premeasured dose of an injectable medicine, especially morphine.

examples.text: The medic carried a <w>syrette</w> of morphine in his kit to quickly relieve pain on the battlefield.
He broke the seal on the <w>syrette</w> and administered the emergency medicine to the wounded soldier.

senses.sense_definition: A proprietary type of collapsible tube with a hypodermic needle designed for administering a single dose of medicine.

examples.text: During World War II, each field medic was equipped with a <w>Syrette</w> containing morphine.
The combat doctor relied on the patented <w>Syrette</w> to deliver immediate pain relief under fire.
